direction-type.words: Note: The "Reading as G Bari" lines are meant for if you are reading music written for a G Bari.
The "Reading as B♭ Bari" lines are meant for if you're reading music written for B♭ Bari.
All lines assume you're using a G Bari, and the fingerings will correlate with the notes on your sheet music
Note: Instruments can play above and below the effective range, but is notated as the prefered playing range for most applicaitons
